recent.text: Prior to today’s series finale vs. Detroit, the Chicago White Sox have returned right-hander Huascar Brazobán from his injury rehabilitation assignment at Class AAA Charlotte, reinstated him from the 15-day injured list and optioned left-hander Chris Murphy to Charlotte.
